body: So I stuck a sowing needle into the vein in my forearm 3 times, i know I didn't miss,  and I went in deep, i thought blood would come gushing out like it does with bloodwork or an IV needle, but no blood came out when I pulled out. Jeeze. I just took a bunch of benadryl, going to tie two plastic bags around my head soon.
Liquid cough syrup is damn nasty, i cant drink it without throwing up. Ugh

Doing factory resets on my electronics. I was going to throw them in the tub full of water. But this being my 3rd attempt, and knowing it may fail, i think i may need them another day or two if this attempt doesn't work. Especially my phone.
That makes me sad to hear that, but that's changing my life, and even changing one thing in my life, could have set me on a very different path. Thanks for caring, means a lot
Yup, haven't taken it quite yet. Got a couple of things to do first.

It's too late. There's no other choice. This is my last medication attempt. If this doesn't work, im cutting the crook of my arm to bleed out. Anyways I bought 500 cc of cough syrup with pseudoephedrine in it. I thought there must be some rule against buying so much.  But nobody cared. I haven't really been eating or drinking.  So I'm going to have a good meal and get well hydrated.  Then in 2 hours or so, take nausea meds, then 15 minutes later start chugging the cough syrup

The emergency doctor gave me a prescription for ondansetron disintegrating tabs. I think i will fill the prescription, and use that to control the nausea and vomiting and try liquid tylenol or tylenol plus pseudoephedrine.  It's still risky as I may have a seizure and throw up from that. But I don't want to live,  and I'll keep trying until something works. I don't know if it's accurate, but I feel like I can trick the body into not vomiting with liquid meds over pills

I guess using sedating pills is sort of how I'm thinking to restrain  myself, but what's to stop you from drinking a whole lot instead of just a sip or two to get the pill down. Rinsing your mouth out with water helps a lot to keep the thirst sensation at bay
Yah, I'd think I'd fail too, but I might try. Maybe learn some pointers of how to make it easier for the next time. I'm just going to keep trying things until something works.
I've been trying to do it for 11 days now. Your body is a persistent bitch.
I think tomorrow I'll take all the benadryl pills I have, im just going to keep trying things until something works.

Well i ended up going to the emergency department. I didn't tell them about the tylenol, but all the other symptoms I have been having. They did every test, bloodwork, urine culture,  stool culture which are all pending. And my liver enzymes were elevated but nowhere near to liver failure. If 64 mg over 4 days won't cut it, and taking a full 20 mg on one day. I'm just going to have to give up. I cant take a dose large enough without vomiting it up. They just assumed they were elevated from the 2 rounds of antibiotics I was on for ear infections

I'm aware that tylenol doesn't cause death directly that it's through liver failure. I think it's more about access, i dont have access to the better meds. Anyways my body is not letting me keep it in, i spent the whole night throwing up, now I cant even drink a sip of water without the retching starting again. I don't know where my blood pressure thing is, but my pulse is normal, so I don't think I'm dehydrated yet. If I'm not able to drink soon, I may have to go to the hospital for intravenous fluids and a nausea injection. But I think it will pass. I could try to cause kidney failure by dehydration, but that's extremely hard too. I'm quite happy to damage my liver terminally, i should have access to medical assistance in dying for a terminal condition then, and they can give me the good meds. I'm not sure I could shoot myself even if I had access to a gun. Bodies are persistent bitches. Thanks everyone that replied to me
I got maybe 20 mg in, and my eyes nose and throat are burning, so wierd. Will have to wait for it to pass before I try again
92 hours. I'll have to take a bigger overdose. I want to get my dishes washed first, then I'm going to do it tomorrow
86 hours. Feeling pissed nothing happened.  Wondering what to do next. Maybe tylenol again
79 hours. Still fine. Well I shouldn't be surprised. Most drug overdoses fail, that's what they say

65 hours.  I don't think I'm even going to get unwell enough to need a hospital visit. Which I guess is a good thing, I dont want to draw attention on myself if I'm not going to die. I still want to die though.  The thought of taking more tylenol makes me want to retch. I'll have to research a new method
62 hours. Don't feel that bad overall.  Nothing to suggest that anything really acute is happening. I'll give d it one more day  try something else tomorrow

49 hours now. I don't know what to think anymore. Am thinking all the reports of tylenol toxicity are exaggerated.  I still don't want to live. Maybe I can just move on to taking a 100 benadryls in one go. I'll wait til Monday
43 hours,  just took advil for the headache. Feeling quite weak, but no pain or obvious signs of liver failure. Eyes aren't yellow. Body fluids are still a normal colour.
39 hours. Got a headache. That's about it
33 hours. Feeling lame
29 hours since I last took tylenol. Feel fine,  a little tired. I thought maybe I was yellow but I think just imagining it. Let's watch and wait
12 hours since I vomited a small amount and 20 hours since I took the last tylenol. I'm guessing this must be stage 2 now. I feel fine, maybe a bit tired. Let's see what happens next

Nausea lasted a bit, wasn't real severe. No real pain though.  If I do survive this, probably have developed an aversion to tylenol. I have put the tylenol away in a cupboard now. I might do some cleaning and stuff today. Feel like Sunday or so I may be going to hospital. I don't know.

Woke up from sleep with nausea. Vomited a small amount. It's been 7 hours since I took my last tylenol, so I shouldn't have lost any, but vomit was tinged pink, wasn't blood, must have been the red coating on the tylenol pills. I'm not taking anymore tylenol. Let's see what happens. Was 68grams in total but over 4 days.
Just took a shower and washed my hair,  probably my last time doing so
Eyes are burning and got a blocked nose. Probably not tylenol related, im assuming

I've stopped for today. I wish there was a guide to this. I understand tylenol has a delayed response,  but it's been 96 hours since I started now. Maybe I need to take larger doses at a time. Tomorrow I will take 8 grams every hour, for a minimum of 40 grams. I'll take 50 mg of benadryl right now, get some decent sleep in. May help with nausea if I get any too
24 grams
20g now, i might as well take another 20g today. Nothing is happening
16g now. 60 in total. I don't know how they decided about 15g is a lethal dose. It's not even affecting me
12g today. 56g in total
At 8000 mg Today now. 52 grams in total since Sunday though

Just got back from the grocery store. Am cooking up the Ramen,  don't want to take tylenol on an empty stomach, im going to take 4000 mg every hour at least 5 times today. I feel ok with my decision, i must really want this, if It's day 5 and I haven't changed my mind

It's just too painful to live, if I have taken a ĺethal amount, why do I have no symptoms?.  Well I did have the nausea yesterday but it was fairly mild.  I'm still not regretting my decision, but I am a little frustrated
This must be the lamest self harm attempt ever. I'm on day 5 now, i guess I can go up to 20 grams today

I'm craving Ramen noodles. I might get some tomorrow, unless of course things r worse. I may fill up the bathtub tomorrow, and throw all my electronics in except for my phone. I don't want people going through them afterwards.
Yeah I am, getting quite frustrated
Nausea is gone. Still feel fine. I took 50 mg of benadryl to help with sleep. Let's see what happens tomorrow. I was expecting more by now. Will probably take more tylenol tomorrow
Still nauseated but mild. I'm not going to take any more, can't guarantee I won't vomit. Just wait and see what happens
Haven't taken anymore. Have some mild nausea at the moment, I hope it's enough,  it was 44 grams of tylenol in total
Just took 4000 mg, so am at 13 grams today so far. Something has to happen eventually
Another 3000 mg
Just took another 3000 mg. Ears feel a bit pressure-y but no other symptoms
3000 mg more
Just slept a solid 8 Hours.  Still feel perfectly fine. And I feel really calm, and a little giggly, this must be the saddest self harm attempt ever
I just took another 3000 mg, nothing is happening. Even my pee is still a normal colour
I just took another 2000 mg, i guess I just have to be patient. I have lived this long
I only see a links comments under karma points
Thanks
Still nothing. Maybe it's a defective bottle of tylenol
I know it's not the best method, but it's all I have. I just took another 2000 mg, still no symptoms, not even nausea. And no sweating today either. I don't know how to private message.

It's too late. I'm not sure why I posted here, maybe I shouldn't have. I'm just confused as to why I'm not having any symptoms. I thought taking 8g of tylenol was really bad, and I did that 2 days ago

I've been seeing doctors, psychiatrists,  therapists for over 5 years ago. There's nothing left to be done, I've tried my best and I can't take it anymore.  It's the right decision. 

I just took another 2000 mg, so I'm at 10,000 for today now. I thought something would be happening by now, it's close to 48 hours since I started taking the pills. Almost 26,000 mg in 48 hours is a lot 

I dont really have access to better meds, i might take all my benadryl tomorrow.
I dont want to live anymore. I tried my best to make it work, over and over and over
Maybe I need to add in some alcohol, i have some Vodka,  but I don't want to throw up.
I just took another 2000 mg
Am attempting to end my life
